research_question: How much cost change is attributable to replacing same-city administrative customer responsibility with directed-road-nearest responsibility, and how much additional value remains when all depots may serve all customers?

instance_population.selection_rule: Use every China81 instance with at least one customer whose loader customer_home_depot differs from the depot minimizing directed CV road distance from depot to customer. No instance is selected from search outcomes.
instance_population.main_display_rule: Among selected instances, use the highest input mismatch rate as the named main display; ties are broken by larger customer count and then instance_id.
instance_population.formal_execution_order_rule: Descending input mismatch rate, then descending customer count, then instance_id; finish and persist all 30 units of one instance before starting the next.
instance_population.reason_for_all_six: Natural nonzero mismatch is rare and weak. Using the complete six-instance population avoids result-dependent case selection and supplies three 150-customer and three 200-customer instances for scale robustness.

IND.name: independent delivery
IND.responsibility: Each customer is assigned to loader customer_home_depot, derived as customer city to the unique same-city depot.

ZONE.name: zoned delivery
ZONE.responsibility: Each customer is reassigned to the depot minimizing directed CV road distance from depot to customer, with depot_id as deterministic tie-break.

JOINT.name: joint delivery
JOINT.responsibility: The ZONE responsibility map and initial route skeleton are retained as the common reference, while the service lock is removed and any depot may serve any customer.

effects.sign_convention: Positive means the later arm costs less; negative means it costs more; zero is retained.

budget.unit: complete candidates submitted to the full model evaluator

convergence_probe.instance_selection_rule: Largest customer count, then highest mismatch count, then instance_id among the six selected inputs.

budget.formal_cap_selection_rule: If the long probe naturally exhausts candidates, candidate_cap = 100 * ceil((actual_consumption + 1) / 100). Otherwise, if the incumbent first enters a 1e-4 relative band of the final search best and remains covered by 200 later search evaluations, candidate_cap = 100 * ceil((confirmation_evaluation + 2) / 100). Otherwise candidate_cap = 1500. The common formal cap is max(400, candidate_cap), bounded above by 1500.
budget.early_termination: Candidate exhaustion or no improvement is normal and its actual consumption and reason are reported.

candidate_classification.legal_infeasible: A null objective caused by a whitelisted complete-model capacity or time-window infeasibility; consumes budget and does not halt.
candidate_classification.hard_lock_filter: FILTERED_HARD_HOME_DEPOT_LOCK; consumes budget and is removed before elite or route-pool entry.
candidate_classification.technical_error: Any unclassified exception or nonzero error_candidates; halt immediately and preserve the trace.

concurrency.load_rule: Do not start E3 search while another ReSETP experiment already occupies the two allowed workers.

reporting.overall_summary: Equal weight across the six instance rows; do not weight by customer count or select seeds.
reference_comparisons: Chen Yudie 2025 Table 9: JOINT versus ZONE total cost -3.44%, carbon +2.86%, vehicles 8 to 7
Chen Yudie 2023 Table 5: JOINT versus ZONE total cost -6.09%, distance -6.34%, time -5.07%, carbon -4.79%
reporting.figures: No figure is precommitted. A figure enters the main text only if it materially clarifies the mismatch-effect relationship beyond the required one-row-per-instance table; otherwise no figure is produced.

halt_conditions: Any route_pool_sp.py or epochal_hgs.py search-semantics change
Any input, plan, trace, or independent-recompute denominator failure
